## Technical Expertise Breakdown

### 1. Frontend & Mobile Development
- **React.js & React Native:** Advanced component architecture, state management (Redux, Zustand, React Query), performance optimization, native module integration, responsive layouts.
- **Astro & Next.js:** Static Site Generation (SSG), Server-Side Rendering (SSR), SEO-focused hydration, micro-animations, glassmorphic UI design.
- **Styling:** CSS3, Modern Tailwind CSS, Flexbox/Grid, custom micro-interactions, responsive cross-browser styling.

### 2. Backend & API Infrastructure
- **Node.js / Express:** Scalable RESTful APIs, WebSockets, JWT/OAuth authentication, middleware security.
- **Django & Python:** ORM optimization, secure REST framework APIs, admin customization, automated background tasks.
- **Laravel & PHP:** MVC architecture, Eloquent ORM, Blade, secure session handling and payment hook handling.

### 3. Fintech & Security Integration
- **Mobile Money Payments:** Custom API adapters for MTN Mobile Money, Moov Money, FedaPay, and Kkiapay.
- **Virtual Cards & Digital Wallets:** Transaction ledger architecture, balance validation, fraud detection routines, virtual card tokenization.
- **Cybersecurity Practice:** OWASP vulnerability mitigation, input sanitization, data encryption (AES-256, RSA), SSL/TLS configuration, secure API header management (CORS, CSP, HSTS).

## Detailed Project Case Studies

### 1. Bhilal Programming Language (v1.2.0)
- **Goal:** Provide a local, accessible programming language with French & English syntax that transpiles to JavaScript and includes built-in security analysis tools.
- **Key Features:** Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) support, bilingual keywords (`classe`/`class`, `fonction`/`function`, `retourner`/`return`), interactive REPL console, network ping and security scan utilities.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/7Bhil/bhilal-language

### 2. Vitch (Fintech Demo Application)
- **Goal:** Demonstrate an end-to-end digital wallet and mobile money payment system.
- **Key Features:** Real-time transaction history, virtual card generation, deposit and withdrawal simulations via mobile money, security PIN verification.

### 3. Bhil Cours (Educational Platform)
- **Goal:** Centralized interactive coding practice platform for beginners and intermediate developers.
- **Architecture:** React frontend with Django backend, providing progressive exercises, syntax highlighting, and execution progress tracking.

### 4. Bloc Républicain - Arrondissement
- **Goal:** Public institutional application for information dissemination and initiative tracking.
- **Architecture:** Fast responsive web application built for accessible viewing across low-bandwidth mobile networks in Benin.
